seed: Assume positions live on a lattice. Infer the step size and bounds from the data and write movement as lattice moves with explicit bound and obstacle checks.

synth.notes: Player moves on a 3px lattice within an invisible floor (room x30-59,y30-59 + corridor x6-29,y42-50); terrain pixel objects are decorative. A move into a pushable block slides it (player stays); contacted blocks join the chain, which packs against the floor edge or a socket's inset-1 interior. Click(action 6) promotes a block's rect to player (old player removed); tokens re-named token_i by (y,x). Unconfirmed: actions 2/5/7, exact-fit socket entry.
